Prime Locations for Billboard Advertising in Tokyo
Shinjuku

One of Tokyo's major commercial and transportation hubs, Shinjuku brings together office workers, shoppers, residents and visitors throughout the day. Its concentration of business, retail, entertainment and transport makes it an important environment for high-visibility OOH campaigns.
Shibuya

Known for its retail, entertainment and cultural destinations, Shibuya attracts residents, commuters and visitors throughout the day. Advertising in this area allows brands to connect with audiences within one of Tokyo's most active commercial districts.
Minato

Minato is home to major business districts, commercial developments and international companies. OOH placements in the area provide opportunities to reach professionals, commuters and audiences visiting the district for business and leisure.
Chiyoda

As a central business and government district, Chiyoda attracts office workers, commuters and visitors throughout the day. Its concentration of businesses and institutions makes it a relevant environment for professional and urban audiences.
Toshima

Toshima includes major commercial and transport areas such as Ikebukuro, bringing together commuters, shoppers, residents and visitors. Its combination of retail and transit environments creates opportunities for brands to engage audiences throughout the day.
Musashino

Located in western Tokyo, Musashino extends campaign opportunities beyond the central Tokyo wards. Its commercial and residential environments provide access to audiences across the wider metropolitan market.
Hachioji

Hachioji is an important commercial and residential centre in western Tokyo. Its location within the metropolitan area provides advertisers with opportunities to connect with audiences beyond central Tokyo.
Saitama

Located north of Tokyo, Saitama forms part of the wider Greater Tokyo metropolitan area and has strong commuter connections with the capital. Including Saitama can help brands extend their campaign reach beyond central Tokyo.
Yokohama

Yokohama is a major city in Kanagawa Prefecture and part of the wider Greater Tokyo metropolitan area. Its large urban population and strong connections with Tokyo create opportunities for advertisers to reach audiences beyond the capital.
Why Advertise in Tokyo?
Reach a Large and Diverse Urban Audience

Tokyo brings together professionals, commuters, residents, shoppers, tourists and international visitors. OOH placements across different environments allow brands to connect with audiences throughout their daily routines.
Connect With Commuters

Tokyo's extensive transportation infrastructure creates opportunities for brands to reach audiences as they move between residential areas, workplaces, shopping destinations and entertainment districts.
Reach Key Commercial Districts
Areas such as Shinjuku, Shibuya, Minato and Chiyoda provide environments where brands can connect with audiences in business, retail and entertainment settings.
Build High-Impact Brand Visibility
Large-format billboards and digital screens provide prominent visual environments for brands to communicate with audiences in busy public spaces.
Use Flexible DOOH Advertising
Digital out-of-home allows advertisers to use dynamic creative and flexible scheduling, making it suitable for campaigns that need to respond to time, location or campaign requirements.
Connect With Audiences Around Major Tokyo Events

Tokyo hosts major cultural, sporting and seasonal events throughout the year, bringing increased movement and attention to different parts of the city. These moments can create opportunities for brands to align DOOH campaigns with relevant audiences and locations.
Tokyo Marathon

The Tokyo Marathon brings runners, spectators and visitors into the city's streets, creating a major annual sporting moment and an opportunity for brands to build visibility around the event environment.
Sumida River Fireworks Festival

Held during Tokyo's summer season, the Sumida River Fireworks Festival attracts large crowds around the Sumida and Taito areas. Its concentrated audience movement makes it a relevant moment for brands looking to align OOH activity with seasonal events.
Seasonal Festivals and Celebrations

Tokyo's annual calendar includes cultural festivals, fireworks displays, sporting events and seasonal celebrations. These recurring moments allow brands to consider location-specific campaigns around periods of increased audience activity.
